title: WARREN BUFFETT'S BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Berkshire still looks like Berkshire — until you get to the new name.  
A fresh $689M slice of Italian software firm Bending Spoons (BSP) is  
the only new stock in a $304B book, and they nearly doubled Lennar  
(LEN) after adding about $1.05B. They also added 12.44% to Delta  
(DAL), while cutting Bank of America (BAC) by about $1.5B, slashing  
VeriSign (VRSN) by 34.12% and Capital One (COF) by 61.67%.  
  
This is everything they owned as of the end of Q3:  
  
\- $75.9B of Apple (AAPL)  
\- $46.1B of American Express (AXP)  
\- $34.4B of Coca-Cola (KO)  
\- $27.1B of Alphabet (GOOGL)  
\- $24.8B of Bank of America (BAC) (cut 5.70%)  
\- $17.2B of Chevron (CVX)  
\- $14.7B of Occidental (OXY)  
\- $11.2B of Moody's (MCO)  
\- $11.1B of Chubb (CB)  
\- $9.26B of Alphabet (GOOG)  
\- $7.40B of Kraft Heinz (KHC)  
\- $5.38B of Delta Air Lines (DAL) (added 12.44%)  
\- $5.02B of DaVita (DVA)  
\- $3.23B of SiriusXM (SIRI)  
\- $2.12B of Lennar (LEN) (added 98.56%)  
\- $2.05B of Kroger (KR) (cut 10.26%)  
\- $1.67B of VeriSign (VRSN) (cut 34.12%)  
\- $1.03B of Liberty Live (LLYVK)  
\- $1.02B of Ally (ALLY)  
\- $1.00B of New York Times (NYT)  
\- $689M of Bending Spoons (BSP) (new)  
\- $472M of Liberty Live (LLYVA)  
\- $370M of Nucor (NUE) (cut 14.91%)  
\- $366M of Louisiana-Pacific (LPX)  
\- $222M of Capital One (COF) (cut 61.67%)  
\- $172M of Macy's (M) (added 2.60%)  
\- $68M of NVR (NVR)  
\- $44M of Lennar (LEN.B) (added 85.50%)  
\- $20M of Jefferies (JEF)  
\- $0.5M of D.R. Horton (DHI)  
  
No full exits this quarter.  
  
Holdings are as of September 30, per Berkshire's Q3 13F filing. 13Fs  
only cover long U.S.-listed positions and lag the market, so the fund  
may have changed these since then.  
  
Curious what stands out to people here — the Bending Spoons stake, the  
almost-doubled Lennar position, or the Capital One cut?
